\subsection{Experiment 07: Packet-loss / node-dropout robustness}

\subsubsection{Experimental objective}

Quantify the degradation of F-SIBS under stochastic uplink packet loss and compare against NDIC-real and LDMIC-equiv under the same adapted loss model, with a 30-trial multi-trial study.

\subsubsection{Statistical analysis}

The multi-trial study reports mean $\pm$ std over 30 independent dropout draws per (rate, variant); the SSIM profile is flat over 0--30\% loss (max observed mean change $-0.0004$) and the per-cell std (0.002--0.003) exceeds the trend. The notebook defines no formal degradation test; 'graceful degradation' is therefore reported as an observed description.

\subsubsection{Scientific findings}

\paragraph{F-E07-01.} Final SSIM is essentially flat over 0-30\% uplink packet loss for all four F-SIBS variants (30-trial means; max observed change -0.0004). Numerical evidence: stat\_packet\_loss.csv (recorded): per-cell std 0.0018-0.0033 dwarfs the mean trend. Interpretation: Federated dictionary construction degrades gracefully under uplink loss on this scene.. Limitations: Single scene (dino); loss applied to basis transmissions only; no retransmission model.. Supporting: Fig.~\ref{fig:exp07-packet-loss-robustness}, Table~\ref{tab:exp07-stat-packet-loss}.

\paragraph{F-E07-02.} At every loss rate of the sweep the F-SIBS variants exceed NDIC-real by ~0.19 SSIM and LDMIC-equiv by ~0.15 SSIM (single-run). Numerical evidence: exp7\_packet\_loss\_robustness\_table.csv (recorded). Interpretation: Under the adapted loss model, federated basis sharing retains a large quality advantage over the distributed baselines.. Limitations: Baselines evaluated under the same adapted loss model, not their native protocols; single run.. Supporting: Fig.~\ref{fig:exp07-packet-loss-robustness}, Table~\ref{tab:exp07-sweep}.

\paragraph{F-E07-03.} Global dictionary coherence remains 0.9127-0.9634 under 0-20\% loss (F-SIBS variants, single-run). Numerical evidence: exp7\_packet\_loss\_robustness\_table.csv coherence column. Interpretation: Dropped transmissions do not destabilise the learned dictionary in the recorded runs.. Limitations: Coherence of baselines undefined (NaN by design).. Supporting: Fig.~\ref{fig:exp07-packet-loss-robustness}, Table~\ref{tab:exp07-sweep}.

\paragraph{F-E07-04.} Single-run sweep shows non-monotonic SSIM steps (e.g. F-SIBS\_3: 0.7503 at 20\% vs 0.7463 at 0\% loss). Numerical evidence: exp7\_packet\_loss\_robustness\_table.csv; multi-trial std ~0.002-0.003. Interpretation: Consistent with stochastic dropout-draw noise; flagged rather than smoothed.. Limitations: n=1 sweep; multi-trial grid uses coarser rates \{0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3\}.. Supporting: Fig.~\ref{fig:exp07-legacy-loss-panel}, Table~\ref{tab:exp07-sweep}.
